violated_contract: A relayout-time child-relocation lookup for a lazily built sliver must resolve each mounted child to a unique target index. Chat failed replies share the backend placeholder id 0000 (ServerMessage.empty), so a findChildIndexCallback keyed by message id maps every mounted placeholder to the same index when an older-history prepend shifts positions; SliverMultiBoxAdaptorElement.performRebuild stores relocations in a per-index map, so the second write overwrites the first and a failed-reply row (with its Try Again surface) is dropped or the child-order assertion fires.
canonical_prevention: Give every row one stable UI identity shared by the sliver's keys, the relocation callback, shouldRebuild, and visibility tracking: persisted messages key by id, placeholder/optimistic rows key by ObjectKey(message) so instance identity disambiguates duplicates. Cover with a widget test that mounts two failed replies, prepends older history, and asserts both Try Again rows stay hit-testable and retry recovers the selected one; the test must fail on indexOf-based relocation.
